background: HSBC Holdings is the listed holding company of HSBC, one of the world's largest banks, with its main earnings in Hong Kong and the UK and a global transaction banking, wealth and trade franchise.
synthesis: Fitch rates the holding company A+, stable, and S&P A- on a positive outlook, with the last move S&P's downgrade to A- on 13 May 2020. Consolidated capital is strong against UK majors, with CET1 of 14.1% above the peer median and leverage of 4.9% at the median. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 134% is in the bottom quarter, while NSFR of 140% is in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 and leverage have each fallen 0.5 points and NSFR 5 points; the flagged news is management change, led by the finance director's planned departure reported on 10 Sep 2026.
